content.text:
OPEN RELAY REGISTRY

This is a public directory of hosts that answer on the open network. It is run by the Open Relay Foundation in Zurich and paid for by its members.

Open the Directory section to see what is listed. Any address listed here can be added to your own address book.

Being listed does not mean a host welcomes you. It means the host exists and its operator has not asked us to remove it.

Questions: registrar@openrelay.example

LISTING POLICY · IN FORCE FROM 1 JANUARY 2034

A host is listed when it has answered on the open network for thirty days in a row.

A host is removed when:
  - its operator asks, in writing, and proves ownership
  - a court with jurisdiction in Switzerland orders it
  - it stops answering for ninety days

The Foundation does not record why a host is used, and does not publish who looks a host up. Lookup records are kept for ninety days for abuse handling and then destroyed.

OPERATOR CONTACTS · PUBLISHED AT THE OPERATORS' REQUEST

POLARMESH-IX (Polar Mesh Exchange, Tromsø)
  Operator: Ivar Nordvik, operator@polarmesh.example
  Ivar is at the TROMSO-2 site until the 20th and reads mail when the weather lets him.
  Member accounts and abuse desk: Signe Dahl, signe.dahl@polarmesh.example
  Signe answers members and staff only.

  Notice to peers: maintenance is on Thursdays from 02:00 to 03:00. The TROMSO-2 station is on port ix-07, which moves to the backup switch for the hour.

KESTREL-GW (Kestrel Wireless Cooperative, Nairobi)
  Contact through the Thursday meeting. No address given.

Other operators have asked not to be listed here.
